title: Initialize Node.js project structure
description:
FILES TO CREATE:
- /work/package.json (Node.js project config with express, jest dependencies)
- /work/tsconfig.json (TypeScript configuration)
- /work/src/index.ts (Application entry point)
- /work/.gitignore (Node.js gitignore)
- /work/README.md (Project documentation)

Initialize the project with: npm init, install express, typescript, ts-node, jest, @types/*
